childNodes.textContent: Your process — Blocks proof of concept

Blocks proof of concept — a business process becomes four steps, one
  smart block on each, set up a little, then run. For you, or for a
  client in their brand.

  Skinned as the marketing site in the new brand (sell-to-many remix 24:
  ?theme=brand&layout=mvp2, brand book v5). The page, the builder frame and the client's
  app all use that site's own stylesheets and brand lookup, linked from
  sell-to-many/ rather than copied, so it looks like the same product.

  Three ways in: ?t=edm, ?t=screening, ?combo=1. See README.md here.
  With a model: python3 live.py --blocks

childNodes.textContent: Let’s build it from how the job gets done today. I’ll turn it into four steps, one smart block on each.
The CommBank assistant, in CommBank’s voice
Now tell me how the job gets done today at CommBank: the steps, who does them, the tools. A messy list is fine, or attach the procedure.

Complaints come in by email, phone and our web form. The team lead reads each one, logs it in a spreadsheet, decides who handles it and forwards it. The handler investigates, drafts a reply in Word, gets the team lead to check it, then emails the customer.
As I read it, in the order it happens, with the tool each step lives in.
Receive complaint by email, phone, or web form
Send draft reply to team lead
Team lead approves or requests changes
Team lead sends approved reply to customer

Complaints arrive via email, phone, and web form. The team lead logs each complaint in a spreadsheet, assigns it to a handler, who investigates and drafts a reply for the team lead to review before sending it to the customer.
To respond to each complaint with an approved reply.
The team lead starts the process by logging and assigning complaints; handlers investigate and draft responses; the team lead reviews and approves replies.
An approved response email is sent to the customer for each complaint.
This looks like the Customer complaints template
Take the complaint, add evidence, draft the reply, team lead approves it. Its four steps: Complaint → Evidence → Reply → Team lead.
Jev picked from the 20 templates we have, and how sure it is (confidence 100%).
, in CommBank’s brand. Now set up each block. Everything you change shows on the right as you go, and you can ask me for changes below.
Who it’s from and what happened.
Each time it runs, the person running it fills these in. Add, rename or remove fields, or ask the builder below.
Changes show in the app as you make them
